statement: Given \(R, r > 0\), two circles of radii \(R\) and \(r\) intersect at two points. The line joining the two intersection points is at distance \(D\) from the center of one circle and distance \(d\) from the center of the other. What is the smallest possible value of \(D + d\)?

Let \(A\) be a set of \(n\) nonneg­ative integers. Say \(A\) has property \(\mathcal{P}\) if the set \(\{x + y \mid x, y \in A\}\) has \(\binom{n}{2}\) elements. The \textit{diameter} of \(A\) is the largest element minus the smallest element. Let \(f(n)\) be the smallest diameter of any set \(A\) with property \(\mathcal{P}\). Show that \(n^2 \leq 4f(n) < 4n^3\).

a) Show that there are no functions \(f, g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) such that \(g(f(x)) = x^3\) and \(f(g(x)) = x^2\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\).

b) Let \(S\) be the set of all real numbers greater than \(1\). Show that there exist functions \(f, g : S \to S\) satisfying \(g(f(x)) = x^3\) and \(f(g(x)) = x^2\) for all \(x \in S\).

Let \(V_n = \sqrt{F_n^2 + F_{n+2}^2}\), where \(F_n\) is the Fibonacci sequence (\(F_1 = F_2 = 1\), \(F_{n+2} = F_{n+1} + F_n\)). Show that \(V_n\), \(V_{n+1}\), \(V_{n+2}\) are the sides of a triangle with area \(\dfrac{1}{2}\).

Let \(f(x) = x^2 - C\) where \(C\) is a rational constant. Show that there are only finitely many rationals \(x\) such that the sequence \(\{x, f(x), f(f(x)), \ldots\}\) is finite (i.e., eventually periodic).
A map \(f\) of the plane to itself takes every pair of points at distance \(1\) to a pair of points at distance \(1\). Show that \(f\) preserves all distances.
